title: LLM prompt artifact in source code
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin ai-fingerprint observed rules
description:
Detects hardcoded prompt-engineering literals in source code (persona prompts, anti-hallucination annotations, system instruction fragments such as 'Core Judgment Rules:'). These literals are typical of LLM-augmented codebases.

Aggregated from 1 fingerprint hit(s) across 1 file(s). Sample paths: apps/foo/bar.py.
